title: The landing page checklist: find why visitors don't buy
seoTitle: Landing page checklist: why visitors don't buy
description: A landing page checklist in six parts: first screen, offer, proof, objections, form and mobile speed. Plus AI prompts to run a full landing page audit.
lede: This landing page checklist follows the order a visitor reads: the first screen, the offer, proof, doubts, the form or checkout, and speed on a phone. Tick each check, then use two prompts to get your AI to audit the page and find the doubts it leaves unanswered.
